sources.entry: AnnePro-mac - macOS application for controlling AnnePro keyboard over bluetooth.

summary.one_liner: A macOS application for controlling the AnnePro keyboard over Bluetooth, still under development.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS app that controls an AnnePro keyboard over Bluetooth. The app is described as unfinished, with some bugs and unimplemented features. The README says the author uploads lighting and layout information to the keyboard. The README does not list specific features beyond that. Users report bugs or request features through the issue tracker. The README mentions no build steps or source code instructions. Installation uses a downloadable release.
use_cases: configure AnnePro keyboard layout on mac
control mechanical keyboard over bluetooth from macos
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page.
Copy AnnePro.app to your Applications folder.
Right-click the app and choose Open the first time, then click Open in the warning dialog.
Optionally add AnnePro.app under System Preferences > Users & Groups > Login Items to launch at login.
notable: Talks to the keyboard directly over Bluetooth using CoreBluetooth
Can upload layout and lighting settings to the keyboard
Installable as a standard macOS .app bundle with login item support
caveats: Under development with known bugs; the README says some features are unimplemented
Lighting upload can stop halfway through, while layout upload retries until it succeeds
Requires macOS and Bluetooth; the README describes no other platforms
